title: Three Colors · Teams
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Three Colors · Teams with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Select one multicolored object visible to all players. The lead names three visibly different colors on that object. The group can see all three named colors. Form two teams. Each team has four turns; only the lead’s teammates respond or assist. Each success earns the team one point. The higher team score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Three Colors, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The group can see all three named colors.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: The group can see all three named colors.
